Message.Name: Timestamp Message
Message.Description: For bandwidth efficiency reasons, the timestamp for a message is divided into two pieces: the seconds portion and sub-seconds portion. The seconds portion of the timestamp appears in the Timestamp Message, any message on the stream following this message has this seconds portion of time until the next timestamp message. The format is as follows:

Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: Number of seconds since midnight. All messages between this Timestamp Message and the next Timestamp Message will have this value of seconds in their timestamp.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event. The format is as follows:

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: The sub-second portion of the time, in nanoseconds (0-999999999). The second portion of the time is obtained from the most recent timestamp message.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Refer to System Event Codes below

Field.Name: Version
Field.Description: Version of this interface. Currently set to 3.

Field.Name: Sub-version
Field.Description: Sub-version of this interface. Currently set to 0.

Message.Name: Options Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, the options system disseminates directory messages for all symbols eligible for the auction process in the options system.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: The sub-second portion of the time, in nanoseconds (0-999999999). The second portion is obtained from the most recent timestamp message.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID for this option, assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the option root symbol (security symbol)

Field.Name: Expiration Year
Field.Description: Last two digits of the year of the option expiration

Field.Name: Expiration Month
Field.Description: Expiration Month of the option (1-12)

Field.Name: Expiration Day
Field.Description: Day of the Month of expiration (1-31)

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Source
Field.Description: Identifies the source of the option, valid for the trading day.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the unique symbol assigned to the underlying security within the Exchange System.

Field.Name: Option Closing Type
Field.Description: Denotes which System Event is used to determine when trading ceases in this symbol.

Field.Name: Tradable
Field.Description: Denotes whether or not this option is tradable at the exchange:

Field.Name: Minimum Price Variation
Field.Description: Minimum Price Variation for this option:

Message.Name: Trading Action Message
Message.Description: The options system uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of an index or equity option within the options market.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: The sub-second portion of the time, in nanoseconds (0-999999999). The second portion of the time is obtained from the most recent timestamp message.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the options security in the options market. The allowable values are:

Message.Name: Security Open Message
Message.Description: The options system uses this administrative message to indicate when an option has completed the opening process and is now available for auto execution or when the option has closed and is no longer available for auto execution.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: The sub-second portion of the time, in nanoseconds (0-999999999). The second portion of the time is obtained from the most recent timestamp message.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Open State
Field.Description: Reflects the current eligibility for auto execution of the options security in the options market. The allowable values are:

Message.Name: Best Bid And Ask Update Short Form Message
Message.Description: The options system will continuously calculate its best bid and offer position for active options contracts on the options market during the trading day. Whenever the best bid and ask position changes on both sides, the options system will send its best bid and ask update via the data feed for the affected security. A change in bid or ask implies a change in price and/or size. The quote will reflect the highest price displayable in the options system for buy orders/quotes and the lowest price displayable in the options system for sell orders/quotes.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: The sub-second portion of the time, in nanoseconds (0-999999999). The second portion of the time is obtained from the most recent timestamp message.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: Best bid price. NOTE: When converted to a decimal format, this price is in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of contracts on the bid side being displayed in the options market at the current time.

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: Best ask price. NOTE: When converted to a decimal format, this price is in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Ask Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of contracts on the ask side being displayed in the options market at the current time.

Message.Name: Best Bid and Ask Update Long Form Message
Message.Description: This message is the same as the Best Bid AND Ask Update Message – Short Form described above except that Prices and Sizes are 4 byte Integers, the price having 4 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: Bid Price Long

Message.Name: Best Bid Update Short Form Message
Message.Description: The options system will continuously calculate its best bid and offer position for active options contracts on the options market during the trading day. Whenever the best bid or ask position changes on one side but not the other side, the options system will send its best bid or ask update via this feed for the affected security. A change in bid or ask implies a change in price and/or size. The quote will reflect the highest price displayable in the options system for buy orders/quotes and the lowest price displayable in the options system for sell orders/quotes.

Field.Description: The sub-second portion of the time, in nanoseconds (0-999999999). The second portion of the time is obtained from the most recent timestamp message.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Best bid or ask price, the side determined by Message Type. NOTE: When converted to a decimal format, this price is in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of contracts on the bid or ask side being displayed in the options market at the current time.

Message.Name: Trade Report Message
Message.Description: The Trade Report message will be used to relay execution system transactions that are reported during the current business day. The options system only reports one-side of a trade execution on the feed and other data feed products.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: The sub-second portion of the time, in nanoseconds (0-999999999). The second portion of the time is obtained from the most recent timestamp message.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Cross ID
Field.Description: Indicates the internal control number (cross id) associated with the given options trade transaction.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: The Trade Condition is the same as defined in the OPRA specification. Either “Last Sale” or “Transaction”

Field.Name: Price Long
Field.Description: Reflects the transaction (premium) price on the execution.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Current number of contracts traded for an option in one trade.

Message.Name: Broken Trade Report Message
Message.Description: The following message is used in the event that an options trade transaction is broken on the same business day that it is reported.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: The sub-second portion of the time, in nanoseconds (0-999999999). The second portion of the time is obtained from the most recent timestamp message.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Original Cross ID
Field.Description: Indicates the original internal control number (cross id) associated with the given trade transaction in the options market system.

Field.Name: Original Price
Field.Description: Reported Premium Price of an option contract in the original trade report message on this feed.

Field.Name: Original Volume
Field.Description: Reported number of contracts in the original trade report message on this feed.

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Start of Messages. Outside of time stamp messages, the start of day message is the first message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Start of System hours
Value.Description: Start of System hours. This message indicates that NASDAQ is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Market hours
Value.Description: Start of Market hours. This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are available for execution.

Value.Name: End of Market hours
Value.Description: End of Market hours. This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System hours
Value.Description: End of System hours. It indicates that NASDAQ is now closed and will not accept any new orders today. It is still possible to receive Broken Trade messages and Order Delete messages after the End of Day.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: End of Messages. This is always the last message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Non-firm quote
Value.Description: Non-firm quote on both bid/ask sides

Value.Name: bid side firm
Value.Description: Ask side not firm, bid side firm

Value.Name: ask side firm
Value.Description: Bid side not firm, ask side firm
